title: Memories of Goodman and Miller album
summary: He reorchestrated little for the Sauter-Finegan album, done by mail from Germany.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: One thing I thought was interesting was when you had Sauter-Finegan, when you did the one album, Memories of Goodman and Miller, where you each rescored some of the things you had written during that period--
I didn't think that would be honest, I couldn't really see the purpose of that.
If anything it was like you had more orchestral to play with, so it was like seeing a movie in technicolor that you formerly had seen in black
and white. The form was basically the same.

It was all the same thing except reorchestrated. I could see no reason to change it because if I were to change it, why do that piece. So that's why it was that way. Also, it would be a lie to the title of the album.
I did that while I was in Germany, by the way. That came in by mail.
